name: ieee-suite-skills
description: One-stop Claude Code / Codex CLI skill suite for IEEE journal submission. 10 sub-skills covering writing, citation, figures, LaTeX templates, peer-review response, data availability, and venue selection — all anchored in the IEEE Author Center and IEEE Editorial Style Manual.
author: XiansenWu954

defaultPrompts.title: Draft an IEEE TMC abstract
defaultPrompts.prompt: Use ieee-writing to draft a ≤250-word abstract + 5-8 keywords for an IEEE Transactions on Mobile Computing manuscript on {{topic}}.

defaultPrompts.title: Convert BibTeX to IEEEtran
defaultPrompts.prompt: Use ieee-citation to convert this BibTeX block into IEEEtran.bst-conforming entries with month abbreviations and en-dash page ranges.

defaultPrompts.title: Reply to IEEE reviewers point-by-point
defaultPrompts.prompt: Use ieee-response to produce a point-by-point reply to these IEEE reviewer comments. Build an R&R matrix; flag any AUTHOR_INPUT_NEEDED items.

defaultPrompts.title: Pick an IEEE venue
defaultPrompts.prompt: Use ieee-venue-selector to recommend an IEEE journal or conference for a {{N}}-page manuscript on {{topic}} with {{data/code situation}}.
